name: backup_restore
description: Decrypts a stored archive into a new folder of that name under the operator's recovery folder and checks every restored file. Existing folders and the original source are never changed.

backup_id.description: Backup identifier of a stored archive.

name.description: Name of the new folder: one path component, not an existing folder.

node.description: Registered node identifier; URLs are not accepted.

request_id.description: RFC 9562 UUIDv7 operation identifier. Generated by the gateway when omitted; never automatically retry a mutation.

next_steps.description: What the agent plans to do after this step, in plain words. The person at the machine sees it while the agent is paused or in slow motion. A refusal with code paused_by_person did nothing: observe again before the next step and never rerun a macro from its first step.
